rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Classify by action — analgesics kill pain (aspirin, morphine: narcotic vs non-narcotic), antipyretics lower fever (paracetamol), tranquilizers treat mental stress (barbiturates, diazepam), antihistamines block H1 receptors (cetrizine), antibiotics kill microbes (penicillin, streptomycin).  ·  Trick 2: Narrow-spectrum vs broad-spectrum antibiotics: narrow acts on one class (penicillin on Gram+), broad on many (chloramphenicol, tetracycline) — the distinction 2-marker.
